title: Evolution Wall
subtitle: Interactive museum installation

seo.title: Evolution Wall – Interactive Museum Installation
seo.description: Evolution Wall is an interactive museum installation combining software, physical interaction and digital experiences.

overview: An interactive installation that connects digital content with physical interaction to create an accessible museum experience.

content.intro: Evolution Wall explores how software, visual design and physical interaction can work together in a museum environment. The experience was designed to make digital content feel tangible rather than presenting information on a traditional screen.
content.challenge: The project required a clear interaction flow that visitors could understand immediately while also connecting several technical systems behind the scenes.
content.approach: I designed the visitor journey, built the interactive experience and connected the application to supporting services responsible for content and media handling. The visual interface was kept deliberately simple so that the interaction remained the main focus.
content.result: The final installation combines physical interaction with a responsive digital experience and demonstrates how software can become part of a physical environment.

title: Het Fossielenspoor
subtitle: Physical and digital museum experience

seo.title: Het Fossielenspoor – Interactive Fossil Museum Experience
seo.description: Het Fossielenspoor is an interactive museum installation built with React, Raspberry Pi, RFID and ESP32 technology.

overview: A museum experience in which visitors discover fossils through RFID-enabled physical objects, light, sound and an interactive touchscreen.

content.intro: Het Fossielenspoor was designed as a playful way for children to discover fossils through physical exploration. Instead of navigating a conventional interface, visitors interact with physical fossil objects that trigger digital information on a touchscreen.
content.challenge: The experience had to remain simple enough for young visitors while coordinating RFID detection, LED feedback, audio, images and interface states across several pieces of hardware.
content.approach: I created a React and TypeScript interface running on a Raspberry Pi and connected RFID scanning to the application. An ESP32 controls LED feedback around the installation. Fossil information, images and audio are managed through structured data so the content can be updated without rebuilding the interface.
content.result: The finished installation creates a direct connection between touching a physical object and discovering its digital story, combining web development, embedded hardware and interaction design in one experience.

title: Vree
subtitle: Social scheduling app

seo.title: Vree – Social Scheduling App Concept
seo.description: Vree is a social scheduling app concept designed to make finding a moment to meet with friends easier.

overview: A mobile app concept focused on making it easier for friends to discover when they are available at the same time.

content.intro: Vree started from a simple question: when are you free? The application is designed around shared availability instead of long conversations trying to find a date that works for everyone.
content.challenge: Scheduling with friends often requires comparing several calendars, sending multiple messages and repeatedly suggesting dates.
content.approach: The concept combines personal availability, calendar synchronisation and event-specific conversations. Friends can indicate when they are free and immediately discover matching moments.
content.result: Vree turns scheduling into a shared social experience and provides a foundation for a mobile product centred around real-life meetings rather than another general-purpose chat platform.

title: Quibo
subtitle: Book exchange platform

seo.title: Quibo – Book Exchange Web Platform
seo.description: Quibo is a full-stack book exchange platform built with Next.js, Express.js and PostgreSQL.

overview: A full-stack platform that allows readers to exchange books, organise their collection and connect with other book lovers.

content.intro: Quibo was my graduation project for the Graduate Degree in Programming. The platform was created around the idea of giving books a second life while bringing readers together.
content.challenge: The application needed to combine several features such as book management, user accounts, reviews, exchanges and conversations while keeping the experience understandable.
content.approach: I developed the frontend with Next.js and created a backend using Express.js and PostgreSQL. The application allows users to maintain a personal bookshelf, discover books from other users, read reviews and communicate with one another.
content.result: Quibo became a complete full-stack application that combined the technical skills I developed throughout the programme into one graduation project.

title: Sweet Tooth
subtitle: Bakery brand identity

seo.title: Sweet Tooth – Bakery Brand Identity Design
seo.description: Sweet Tooth is a bakery branding project featuring logo design, packaging and a complete visual identity.

overview: A warm and playful visual identity created for a bakery specialising in cheesecakes and handmade desserts.

content.intro: Sweet Tooth is a visual identity created for a bakery focused on cheesecakes and handmade desserts. The goal was to translate the playful and handcrafted character of the products into a recognisable brand.
content.challenge: The identity needed to feel professional while maintaining the warm and approachable personality associated with a small independent bakery.
content.approach: I developed the visual language around typography, colour, logo design and packaging. The individual elements were designed to work together consistently across physical and digital applications.
content.result: The finished identity gives Sweet Tooth a recognisable visual character that can be applied consistently across packaging, communication and promotional material.

title: Studio T
subtitle: Digital agency website

seo.title: Studio T – Digital Agency Website
seo.description: Studio T is a fictional digital agency website designed and developed using HTML and CSS.

overview: A fictional digital agency website created to explore fundamental web design, layout and frontend development.

content.intro: Studio T is a fictional digital agency created as one of my earlier web design projects.
content.challenge: The goal was to build a coherent agency website while learning how structure, typography and layout translate from design into code.
content.approach: The website was developed using HTML and CSS and includes agency information, project presentation and contact content.
content.result: The project formed part of my transition from visual design toward frontend development and helped establish the foundations of my web development skills.

title: Vandotrans
subtitle: Logistics company website

seo.title: Vandotrans – Logistics Company Website
seo.description: A WordPress business website created for logistics company Vandotrans.

overview: A straightforward business website presenting the services and contact information of a logistics company.

content.intro: Vandotrans is a logistics company specialising in the transportation of goods and materials.
content.challenge: The company required a straightforward online presence where customers could quickly understand its services and find contact information.
content.approach: I created the website in WordPress with an emphasis on simple navigation and clear presentation of the company's services.

title: Cereus Creative
subtitle: Previous portfolio website

seo.title: Cereus Creative – Portfolio Website
seo.description: Cereus Creative was a personal portfolio website built using Nuxt.js and Tailwind CSS.

overview: My previous personal portfolio, created to combine my graphic design and development work in a single digital identity.

content.intro: Cereus Creative was an earlier version of my personal portfolio and served as a place to bring together my design and programming work.
content.challenge: My work covered several disciplines, so the website needed to present graphic design and development projects within one consistent visual system.

title: Safe Place
subtitle: Online support platform

seo.title: Safe Place – Laravel Community Platform
seo.description: Safe Place is an online community platform built with Laravel, PHP and Tailwind CSS.

overview: An online platform designed to provide young people with an accessible place for community support and information.

content.intro: Safe Place is a web platform designed around providing young people experiencing bullying with an accessible online community.
content.challenge: The platform needed to support community interaction while allowing users to participate without exposing unnecessary personal information.
content.approach: The application was built with Laravel and PHP and includes a forum, anonymous user functionality and an activities section. Tailwind CSS was used to create the responsive interface.
content.result: The project provided practical experience in backend application development while exploring how digital platforms can support community-focused experiences.

title: Twins See
subtitle: Optician brand identity

seo.title: Twins See – Optician Brand Identity
seo.description: Twins See is an optician branding project including logo design, visual communication and packaging.

overview: A visual identity built around the fictional story of twin sisters creating a modern and approachable optician brand.

content.intro: Twins See is a brand identity created around the fictional optician business of twin sisters Martha and Carla.
content.challenge: The identity needed to communicate professionalism while still feeling personal, accessible and distinct from traditional clinical optical branding.
content.approach: I developed the logo, colour system, graphic elements, icons, packaging, posters and business cards as parts of one coherent visual language.
content.result: The project resulted in a complete visual identity that can consistently communicate the brand across both physical and promotional applications.

title: Dija
subtitle: Beverage brand identity

seo.title: Dija – Beverage Branding and Packaging Design
seo.description: Dija is a colourful beverage brand identity and packaging design project.

overview: A colourful sparkling beverage identity built around freshness, fruit flavours and a playful summer aesthetic.

content.intro: Dija is a fictional sparkling beverage brand created around freshness, energy and colourful fruit flavours.
content.challenge: The packaging needed to distinguish several flavours while allowing every product to remain clearly recognisable as part of the same brand.
content.approach: I developed a flexible visual system using vibrant colour combinations, typography, illustration and repeating graphic patterns across the beverage packaging.
content.result: The final identity creates a coherent product family while allowing each flavour to maintain its own visual personality.
